== calls
ls -q
create --name cpb-box --no-share-skills claude <WORK> <ROOT>/box <TMP>/extra:ro
exec cpb-box bash -lc printf %s 'skills=private' > ~/.cpb-sandbox
policy allow network --sandbox cpb-box api.example.com
policy allow network --sandbox cpb-box router.local
exec cpb-box bash -lc set -o pipefail; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash -s '2.1.263'
secret ls --sandbox cpb-box
secret set-custom --host router.local --env ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN --value real-token --placeholder cpb-box-ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN --sandbox cpb-box
exec -i -e ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=cpb-box-ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -e ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://router.local:9/v1 -e ANTHROPIC_CONFIG_DIR=<ROOT>/box/.cpb-anthropic-config -e CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<ROOT>/box -e CPB_ACCOUNT_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=cpb-box-ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -e EXTRA=1 -e MODEL=glm cpb-box bash -lc cd '<WORK>' && exec env -u ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_AWS_BASE_URL -u ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_MANTLE -u CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_BEDROCK_AUTH -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_VERTEX_AUTH -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FOUNDRY_AUTH -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH -u CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_ANTHROPIC_AWS_AUTH -u CPB_ACCOUNT_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_API_KEY -u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN -u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN -u CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES -u ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS -u ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY -u ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY -u AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK -u CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT -u CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY -u CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY_PASSPHRASE -u ANTHROPIC_PROFILE -u ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID -u ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID -u ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID -u ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN -u ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE -u ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID -u ANTHROPIC_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL -u ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL -u CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL 'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://router.local:9/v1' ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="$CPB_ACCOUNT_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN" 'ANTHROPIC_CONFIG_DIR=<ROOT>/box/.cpb-anthropic-config' claude '-p' 'it'\''s'
